name: RCA DOFSTA oxygen gain, Cabled-07 SKQ201610S (2016), Slope Base Shallow Profiler

annotations.annotation: Due to errors during vendor calibration, a calibration offset (CC_offset) of 4.13 is being applied during the on-demand creation of the L1 Seawater Pressure (dbar) data product from this instrument. For more information please contact help@oceanobservatories.org.
Cause of data gap under investigation.

Data values are within plausible ranges, but lower than usual L0 conductivity values throughout the entire water column during this time period make the salinity, oxygen, and density products suspect.

rca:flags.text: The .cnv has no sbox0Mm/Kg column, so shipboard SBE43 oxygen was converted from ml/l to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula (ml/l x 44660 / (EOS-80 sigma-theta + 1000)), using sal00, t090C and prDM.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied, which matters for the SBE43 oxygen sensor.
Winkler oxygen is the discrete summary's mL/L value converted to umol/kg with the Sea-Bird formula, using the CTD salinity 1, temperature 1 and pressure at each bottle closure.
Winkler bottles deeper than the profiler's deepest sample (199 m) are not used for the ship-sensor gain: 0 of 2 rows from the summary left out.
